candidate_program.name: local_pair_opportunity
candidate_program.rationale: Penalizes jointly collectible conflicts using a weighted edge-deletion lower bound and the heaviest neighbor. Reach is limited to active one-hop neighbors, so the distant cycle remains unresolved; neighbor edge construction can be quadratic in degree.
candidate_program.rule: weight - 0.5 * max(max_conflict_weight, neighbor_pair_floor) + 0.08 * weight / (1 + max(0, degree))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
